title: The beach looks
format: native generator PNG, byte-for-byte ordinary file copies
primary_new_front_rule: Each checked new outfit front is the first reference for its turnaround.

checks.existing_files_preserved: All 112 pre-existing files in lyra/ and moon_ahin/ matched the initial SHA-256 inventory after artwork was saved.

requests.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: character outfit reference sheet. Create one 1536x1024 landscape PNG. A single full-length front view of Lyra, from the crown to bare toes, filling nearly the full canvas height with safe margins. Flat light-grey #E9E9EC background with only a small soft contact shadow under her feet. Soft neutral key light from the upper LEFT. Camera level at her eye height, long-lens/near-orthographic model-sheet view, no camera tilt and no foreshortening. No scale figure or scale markings.

Input image 1 is her APPROVED front, input image 2 her APPROVED turnaround: use them to preserve precisely her face, small pointed ears, hair silhouette, long left-shoulder braid, blue-grey complexion, proportions and house drawing style. Change only her costume to the specified Arc 5 beach outfit. Keep her adult confident expression and her athletic long-legged body, 7.5–8 heads with legs about half her height. The composition gives equal attention to face, outfit and full figure.

Lyra: a tall, strikingly beautiful adult river-folk archer who looks in her early twenties, 182 cm, slender and long-legged with an archer's strong shoulders and a curvy figure; very pale skin with a cool blue-grey tint and faint silver-grey freckles across her nose and cheekbones; small pointed ears with silver ear cuffs; river-blue almond eyes with long lashes and a confident half-smile; long silver-white hair with side-swept bangs and a thick braid over her LEFT shoulder down to her thigh, strung with small pearl and blue-glass beads; a river-blue halter bikini with silver trim and fully opaque fabric, a sheer pale-blue wrap tied at her LEFT hip over the bikini bottoms; her pearl choker and silver arm cuffs, barefoot, no bracer or glove.

The braid and wrap knot are both at her anatomical LEFT, picture-RIGHT in this front view. She wears matching small plain silver upper-arm cuffs and a single pearl on the choker. The halter bikini is river blue #4A90C2 / #33688F with silver #C9D3DC trim. The lightly sheer wrap reads as pale-blue cloth layered over opaque bikini bottoms, secured with a visible tied knot at the left hip; draw a few clean folds. No archer's field gear: no bow, quiver, chest guard, bracer, gloves, boots, flute or sash. Stand tall with weight on her right leg, left knee relaxed, right hand resting lightly at her right hip and left hand lightly touching the braid. Correct anatomically attached hands and bare feet. No wet gloss, no sexual pose, no chest close-up. Eye-level full-body framing throughout.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
notes: Face and adult proportions match approved front; braid and wrap knot anatomical LEFT.
Left upper-arm cuff mostly occluded by braid and bent arm in front view.
